// J1939_TSC1: CAN ID 0x0C000003 (extended), 8 bytes, sender TCM, cycle time 10 ms
// J1939 PGN 0 (0x0) TSC1 — Torque/Speed Control 1, priority 3, PDU1 to 0x00, source address 0x03
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// EngOverrideCtrlMode: start bit 0, 2 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 3
EngOverrideCtrlMode_raw = data[0] & 0x03
EngOverrideCtrlMode = EngOverrideCtrlMode_raw

// EngRequestedSpeed: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.125, offset 0, range 0 .. 8031.875 rpm
EngRequestedSpeed_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
EngRequestedSpeed = EngRequestedSpeed_raw * 0.125
